attributes.title: 57th Mid-South Conference 2027
attributes.venue: University Center, The University of Memphis
attributes.organizer: University of Memphis School of Communication Sciences and Disorders
attributes.summary: The 57th Mid-South Conference takes place on Thursday, February 25, 2027, on the third floor of the University Center at the University of Memphis. Sessions cover pediatric and adult speech-language pathology, audiology topics such as vestibular assessment and single-sided deafness, coding and reimbursement, plus student posters. The main conference is offered for 0.9 ASHA CEUs through the NSSLHA chapter at the University of Memphis.
